description:
Trigger: a user reads README.md to understand what the crate enforces.

README rows misrepresent shipped behavior:
- Line 18 (WebPkiProfile): claims 'path len ≤ 2'. Removed in PKIX-d5rh (commit 9d6c193b) — max_path_len is no longer set.
- Line 19 (SmimeProfile): claims 'max validity 1185 days, path len ≤ 1'. Cap was corrected to 825 days in PKIX-jbvb.7 (commit 79417054). max_path_len removed in PKIX-d5rh.
- Line 20 (CodeSigningProfile): claims 'path len ≤ 1'. Removed.
- All four tier profiles added since PKIX-jbvb.2 (SmimeSponsorValidated, SmimeIndividualValidated, SmimeSponsorValidatedMultipurpose, SmimeIndividualValidatedMultipurpose) are missing from the table.
- README claims SmimeProfile is 'CA/B Forum S/MIME BR v1.0' but the code version stamp says 1.0.14.

Bad behavior: a downstream user reads README, configures their pipeline expecting path-len-2 cap enforcement on TLS chains, ships, and discovers in production that no cap is enforced. README is the first thing every new user reads — it's the most consequential doc surface in the crate.
title: README.md severely stale: wrong validity cap, removed max_path_len, missing 4 profiles
